title: feat(app-shell): a host can ask for no app switcher when the viewer is served one app (objectui#12913)
body:
Fixes #12913
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

- **`AppShellRuntimeConfig`** (published type, `packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts`) gains one optional, host-produced member: `hideSingleAppSwitcher?: boolean`, default `false`. `initRuntimeConfig` reads it as `body.hideSingleAppSwitcher === true` and reads it again from each payload, as it does `singleEnvironment`. No alias, no other spelling. `isSingleAppSwitcherHidden()` is a module-level reader beside `isStorageUsageServed()`. It is not on the package entry, and `index.ts` is untouched (objectui#12733 is editing it).
- **`AppSwitcher`** (`packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`) owns the rule. When the host asks AND its own `activeApps` list (the `active !== false && hidden !== true` list the dropdown draws) has exactly one entry, it draws the app's glyph and name (test id `app-switcher-single-app`) with no trigger and no dropdown. So there is no 「Back to home」, 「All apps」 or 「Settings」 row. The count reads that one list with that one predicate: no second fetch and no second filter. Setup counts as a served app, so a viewer served Setup as well keeps the menu and its 「Settings」 row. Below `sm` the glyph is drawn alone and the name is `max-sm:sr-only`.
- **`AppHeader`**: a comment only. The stand-in occupies the pill's slot, so the platform-stage chip, which `AppBarCrumbTrail` draws right after that slot, still follows it.
- **Docs**: a section in the app-shell README, "One app, no app switcher (host request)", whose `ts` block names the member against the published type. The runtime-config list in `content/docs/guide/console.md` gains the key. Changeset `.changeset/12913-host-single-app-switcher.md` declares `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`.

Without the key, nothing changes: every deployment keeps the pill and the objectui#12605 rows.

## The dispatch's mechanism assumptions, as measured (`origin/main` e1548b794)

1. They hold. `AppSwitcher` filters `a.active !== false && a.hidden !== true` and returns `null` only when no active app is found. `AppHeader` draws the pill under `activeAppName && onAppChange`. `AppShellRuntimeConfig` had no switcher or single-app member: a grep for switcher, singleApp and single-app in `runtime-config.ts` found nothing, while `interface AppShellRuntimeConfig` matched in the same read, so the search itself worked.
2. The list behind the count is `useMetadata().apps`, which `AppSwitcher` already filters. The rule counts that filtered `activeApps` where it is computed.
3. The loader drops unknown keys. `initRuntimeConfig` builds its patch member by member, and ablation leg 3 below (deleting the new read) turns "is ON when the host sends the literal true" red. So the member is read explicitly, the way the existing members are.
4. Inside an app, the chip is drawn by `AppBarCrumbTrail` after the pill's slot, not by the pill. Replacing what the slot holds leaves the chip where it is, and the AppHeader test below checks that.

## Tests (run at `82c1d26`)

- New `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.hostSingleApp-12913.test.tsx` goes through the real loader over a stubbed `GET /api/v1/runtime/config`. With the field set and one served app (a hidden app and an inactive app in the list do not count), there is no trigger, no menu, no 「All apps」 and no button; the glyph and name stand in. CONTROLS: two served apps keep the switcher and 「All apps」; Setup as well keeps it and 「Settings」; a payload without the key keeps today's pill and its rows.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.hostSingleApp-12913.test.tsx` renders the real `AppHeader`, `AppSwitcher` and `PreviewBadge`. The stand-in sits in the slot after the product mark and its rule, and the Preview chip is that slot's next sibling. CONTROLS: two apps keep the pill with the chip beside it; without the key, one app keeps the pill.
- `packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.test.ts` gains the describe block `runtime-config hideSingleAppSwitcher (objectui#12913)`. The field is OFF before init and ON for a literal `true`. It stays OFF when the key is absent, `false`, `'true'`, `1`, or nested under `features`, and OFF when the fetch fails. A later payload without the key withdraws it.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the three files: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 55 passed (55)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/`: `Test Files 101 passed (101)`, `Tests 675 passed (675)`.
- Every other test file that names `runtime-config`, `AppShellRuntimeConfig` or `initRuntimeConfig` (`git grep -l`; 50 files, including `apps/console/src/__tests__/runtimeConfigBootDedup.test.ts` and `faviconAfterNavigation.test.tsx`): `Test Files 50 passed (50)`, `Tests 598 passed (598)`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: `Tests 32 passed (32)`.

## Ablation (the change was committed first)

Each leg used `ablation-replace` in WRAP mode. Each anchor hit exactly once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The final tree was clean (`git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` empty).

| Leg | Mutation | Red (as predicted) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | the rule's `if` becomes `if (false)` | the two one-app `AppSwitcher` cases and the one-app `AppHeader` case (3 of 55) |
| 2 | `activeApps.length === 1` becomes `>= 1` | the two-apps and Setup-as-well CONTROLS, and the `AppHeader` two-apps CONTROL (3 of 55) |
| 3 | the loader's read is deleted | the ON and withdraw loader cases, and the three host-asked rendering cases (5 of 55) |
| 4 | `=== true` becomes `Boolean(...)` | the `'true'` and `1` loader cases (2 of 55) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Chip position.** The card's Target 4 says the 预览版 chip "stays beside the product mark". Here the bar reads mark, rule, app glyph and name, then the chip: the chip follows the app's name in the slot where it followed the pill. Drawing the chip directly beside the mark with no app name would leave the bar with no text name on an object route. The cloud seat's read of the control plane's top bar after the pin bump (the card's second Acceptance item) is where that is judged.
- **Inside a hidden app.** Suppose the host asks, the viewer is served one un-hidden app, and the current app is a hidden one (for example an account app reached from the avatar menu). The stand-in names the current app, and the way back is the product mark (declared home) and `⌘⇧H`. This was read from the code and not pinned.
- **The 「Edit APP in Studio」 row** goes away with the dropdown. The top bar's own Studio button, which shares the same `studioDesignPath`, stays. This was read from the code; the suppressed case's button is not pinned.
- **Outside the claim's literal file list.** The README section and the one-sentence guide edit follow AGENTS.md §5 rule 2 and the dispatch's suggested route.
- **The cloud half**, serving `hideSingleAppSwitcher: true` from the control plane's `createStudioRuntimeConfigPlugin`, belongs to the cloud seat once this lands.
